L.title: Flow 1: Marketing leader
L.sub: Sets direction, funds, organises, governs and leads people through the change.

M.title: Flow 2: Marketer
M.sub: Learns, maps and redesigns workflows, builds the data and tool foundations, and puts safeguards in place.

nodes.short: Set a transformative AI ambition for marketing
nodes.capability: AI vision with transformative growth and innovation ambition
nodes.activity: Set a transformative AI ambition for marketing until it is agreed and owned at the top
nodes.doneWhen: A written AI ambition statement, approved by the senior team, that names growth or innovation goals; leaders describe it consistently when asked.

nodes.short: Choose and prioritise AI use cases
nodes.activity: Choose and prioritise AI use cases until a funded portfolio guides the work
nodes.doneWhen: A use-case portfolio with scoring criteria, owners and status, reviewed on a set cadence.

nodes.short: Track AI impact against business KPIs
nodes.capability: Impact tracking: KPIs and business-level value
nodes.activity: Track AI impact against business KPIs until value is reported routinely
nodes.doneWhen: KPIs measured consistently across functional areas, covering both activities and outcomes, reviewed by leadership at least quarterly; at the highest level, a dashboard linking outcomes to business impact and the business strategy.

nodes.short: Sponsor and role-model AI use
nodes.activity: Sponsor and role-model AI use until leaders visibly use and champion it
nodes.doneWhen: One or more named executive sponsors for AI; leaders' own AI use is observable; the AI budget is reviewed transparently.

nodes.short: Commit and manage the AI budget
nodes.capability: AI investment commitment and cost management
nodes.activity: Commit and manage the AI budget until investment and cost are controlled
nodes.doneWhen: An approved AI budget; cost per tool or workflow tracked against value delivered; a regular cost review.

nodes.short: Map and prioritise workflows
nodes.activity: Map and prioritise workflows until the highest-value ones are chosen for redesign
nodes.doneWhen: Documented end-to-end maps of core workflows, with a ranked list and the prioritisation criteria.

nodes.short: Redesign workflows end to end
nodes.activity: Redesign workflows end to end until the new way of working is embedded
nodes.doneWhen: Records that workflows were reviewed before AI was applied (redesigned or retired); before and after workflow maps showing steps, handovers or approvals removed; the old process retired; teams working the new way by default.

nodes.short: Design human review points
nodes.activity: Design human review points until people check AI output where it matters
nodes.doneWhen: A review-point map by output type and risk level; review logs or sampled records show the checks happen.

nodes.short: Capture and reuse proven workflows
nodes.capability: Feedback, scaling and reuse of proven workflows
nodes.activity: Capture and reuse proven workflows until they scale across teams
nodes.doneWhen: A workflow library or playbook with versions; performance data feeding changes; at least one workflow reused in another team or region.

nodes.short: Orchestrate agents and automation
nodes.activity: Orchestrate agents and automation until they run reliably within set limits
nodes.doneWhen: Agents or automations in production with documented scope and limits; run logs; a named human supervisor for each.

nodes.short: Assign roles and ownership
nodes.activity: Assign roles and ownership until the business leads AI-enabled redesign
nodes.doneWhen: A RACI or equivalent naming owners for AI workflows, outcomes and risks; business leaders named as redesign leads.

nodes.short: Establish a transformation office
nodes.capability: Transformation office with authority to scale
nodes.activity: Establish a transformation office until it has the authority to scale change
nodes.doneWhen: A team charter with decision rights and a budget or mandate; a record of bottlenecks it has removed.

nodes.short: Choose a central or distributed model
nodes.activity: Choose a central or distributed model until responsibilities are clear and working
nodes.doneWhen: A documented central-versus-local split; standards the teams actually follow; no unresolved duplication across teams.

nodes.short: Decide what to build, buy or partner for
nodes.capability: Build, buy and partner decisions; agency management
nodes.activity: Decide what to build, buy or partner for, and manage agencies, until choices are deliberate
nodes.doneWhen: A build, buy or partner decision record; agency briefs and contracts that cover AI use; partners reviewed against the function's standards.

nodes.short: Align marketing with IT, legal, sales and other functions
nodes.activity: Align marketing with IT, legal, sales and other functions until AI work is joined up
nodes.doneWhen: Joint AI priorities agreed with other functions; shared forum or regular meeting; shared data or process agreements.

nodes.short: Build AI literacy for all staff
nodes.activity: Build AI literacy for all staff until everyone can use AI safely and effectively
nodes.doneWhen: Completion and assessment records covering all staff; a short check showing staff can explain AI limits and approved-tool rules.

nodes.short: Train each role in the AI skills it needs
nodes.activity: Train each role in the AI skills it needs until capability is verified in practice
nodes.doneWhen: A role-by-role skills matrix with training mapped to it; evidence of the skills used in live work, not just course completion.

nodes.short: Train leaders to be AI fluent
nodes.activity: Train leaders until they are AI fluent and keep that fluency current
nodes.doneWhen: Leader learning records; leaders can challenge AI claims in review meetings; AI literacy refreshed on a set cadence.

nodes.short: Plan the workforce strategically
nodes.activity: Plan the workforce strategically until roles and skills match AI-enabled work
nodes.doneWhen: A workforce plan with a skills-gap analysis and actions (hiring, reskilling, career paths) that are funded and tracked.

nodes.short: Secure data and tool access
nodes.activity: Secure data and tool access until the right people, and only they, can use the right data
nodes.doneWhen: Access control lists and tool approval records; security review completed before tools go live; regular access audits.

nodes.short: Improve data quality and availability
nodes.activity: Improve data quality and availability until data is AI-ready
nodes.doneWhen: Data quality measures (accuracy, completeness, timeliness) reported against agreed thresholds; AI tools can reach the data they need.

nodes.short: Integrate data and build a semantic layer
nodes.capability: Data integration, architecture and semantic layer
nodes.activity: Integrate data and build a semantic layer until AI can use consistent definitions
nodes.doneWhen: A data architecture diagram; a shared semantic layer, knowledge graph or maintained data dictionary used by AI tools; consistent definitions across systems.

nodes.short: Select and manage the AI tool stack
nodes.activity: Select and manage the AI tool stack until it is rationalised and fit for purpose
nodes.doneWhen: A documented tool stack with integration map; overlapping tools rationalised; a review against workflow needs.

nodes.short: Monitor tool and model performance
nodes.capability: Performance monitoring of tools and models
nodes.activity: Monitor tool and model performance until problems are caught and fixed early
nodes.doneWhen: Monitoring reports on accuracy, reliability, cost and drift; incidents logged with fixes and response times.

nodes.short: Set AI policy and acceptable use
nodes.activity: Set AI policy and acceptable use until it is published, understood and followed
nodes.doneWhen: A published AI policy with an owner and review date; staff acknowledgement or training records; examples of breaches handled.

nodes.short: Align with enterprise governance and oversight
nodes.activity: Align with enterprise governance and oversight until senior ownership is in place
nodes.doneWhen: A link to enterprise AI governance; a named senior overseer; an escalation route that has been used.

nodes.short: Meet regulatory requirements
nodes.activity: Meet regulatory requirements until compliance is assessed and evidenced
nodes.doneWhen: A regulatory register covering AI use; assessments or records of compliance; a named owner and review cadence.

nodes.short: Assess and monitor AI risk
nodes.capability: Risk assessment and monitoring (baseline and advanced)
nodes.activity: Assess and monitor AI risk until risks are identified, rated and managed
nodes.doneWhen: An AI risk register with ratings, owners and mitigations; monitoring reviewed on a set cadence.

nodes.short: Safeguard customer trust, brand and IP
nodes.capability: Customer trust, brand and IP safeguards
nodes.activity: Safeguard customer trust, brand and IP until controls are in place and tested
nodes.doneWhen: Disclosure, provenance, copyright and brand-review checks built into workflows; spot checks or audits show they are applied.

nodes.short: Control agent autonomy and permissions
nodes.activity: Control agent autonomy and permissions until agents act only within approved limits
nodes.doneWhen: A permissions matrix for each agent; action logs; a tested method to stop an agent; human approval for high-risk actions.

nodes.short: Make the case for change and communicate regularly
nodes.capability: Case for change and regular communication
nodes.activity: Make the case for change and communicate regularly until staff understand why and what next
nodes.doneWhen: A change narrative and communication plan; a regular cadence of updates that include results; staff survey or pulse answers show understanding.

nodes.short: Build adoption and champion networks
nodes.activity: Build adoption and champion networks until use spreads beyond early adopters
nodes.doneWhen: A champion network with named members and time allocated; a community of practice that meets; adoption data showing spread beyond early adopters.

nodes.short: Run test-and-learn experiments
nodes.activity: Run test-and-learn experiments until learning is captured and acted on
nodes.doneWhen: Experiment records with hypotheses, learning goals and results; a defined route from test to scale; at least one test scaled.

nodes.short: Address trust, workload strain and transition
nodes.capability: Employee trust, workload strain and workforce transition
nodes.activity: Address trust, workload strain and transition until staff feel supported through the change
nodes.doneWhen: Pulse survey or listening-session results on trust and workload; a log of concerns raised and actions taken.

nodes.short: Reflect AI use and results in performance management
nodes.activity: Reflect AI use and results in performance management until good practice is rewarded
nodes.doneWhen: AI use and outcomes appear in objectives and review templates; recognition or incentive examples.
